summary: SIEM feed s070_single is overloaded: 1ms bursts peak at 3.73 Gbps vs 1 Gbps port (373% capacity, 3 intervals). All other checks (duplicates, encryption, VLANs, one-way, drops) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is delivering unshaped bursts peaking at 3.73 Gbps to a 1 Gbps SIEM port, exceeding line rate by ~273%. No slicing, filtering, or load-balancing is applied to fit the tool's capacity.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM will drop packets during bursts, causing missed events, incomplete flow/metadata, and gaps in detection coverage and correlation.

recommended_fix.why: SIEM needs_full_payload=false per profile, so slicing to headers/metadata preserves detection value while cutting bandwidth to fit 1 Gbps port. If still over threshold, add filtering of irrelevant traffic or load-balance across multiple SIEM receivers.
